text:
Beneath the arch of Life, where love and death,

terror and mystery, guard their sanctuary,

I saw Beauty on a throne,

and though her eyes are abandonment,

I drew her in the simplicity of my breath.

Hers is the gaze-above and below

the heaven that curves over you-

by sea or sky or woman, there is only one law:

to be the servant of her palm and crown.


This is what the Lady of Beauty knows,

in whose praise your voice and hand stir,

long wisdom in the flight of your hair,

the daily beating in your heart and feet,

with what irremediable passion, in how many flights!

How many forms and ways her days possess!




"Soul's Beauty"

translation.title: Soul's Beauty
translation.editorial_note: The translation follows the supplied Spanish Rossetti text while preserving the English source title.
